svg.text: Cells show chi2(case) - chi2(1111); saturated at +/- 1000 for colour only.
Selected A(-4), D(-2) cached non-HHSS; other 14 historical candidate contexts.
White = no effect; red = worsened fit; blue-green = improved fit. Comparison is conditional, not physically certified.
Columns are UV / EFT1 / Wilson / SMEFT on-off bits; 1111 is the all-on baseline.
